scope: Example-only renderer investigation against the same pinned production Bevy source inventory. No product runtime/defaults, dependencies, model, layout algorithms or cache versions changed. Neither tested presentation settings nor event-gated suspension removes the first late-notification stall. Not a performance or comprehension gate pass.
previous_goal_turn_classification: The preceding user-preview turn verified availability; it did not advance the remaining engineering gates. This continuation revalidated the 450-test production source checkpoint, then added and ran bounded renderer experiments.
reference_environment: Apple M5, 16 GiB RAM, macOS 26.6.2, Rust 1.96.0, Bevy 0.18.1, wgpu-hal 27.0.4 Metal; dev profile with repository optimizations. Existing desktop activity/focus/cover state was not controlled. Bundle cache warm, isolated persistence each run, screenshots disabled, scripted ViewerActions only.

production_source.scope: Bevy syntax source inventory, not full runtime architecture extraction.

workspace_test_totals.ignored_scope: Production-bundle continuity test intentionally ignored by default; last explicit pass is in the unchanged production source checkpoint linked below. Not rerun for example-only changes.

helper_tests.scope: Existing phase/occlusion/input tracing tests plus mode preservation/conflicts, occlusion-cycle state, independent window suspension, initial presentation, hidden resize/mode and forced resume, stale events, close cleanup and installed render-schedule ordering around the real surface systems with false conditions (no GPU resources). No fake native handles.

occlusion_probe.scope: Example-only event-gated acquisition suspension. After initial presentation, known-occluded windows are absent from ExtractedWindows during the render schedule and restored after Cleanup. Initial presentation, unknown and unfocused-only windows are permitted. Resume forces surface reconfiguration. This cannot prevent a stall before a late occlusion notification. Window screenshots are prohibited while this probe is installed.

source_identity.phase_provenance: Presentation series used binary 84b4e400264fc04dacf3b6d1a95d379d986907faa71cda7453a8a79b61112c24 before adding the occlusion/cycle probes; a complete helper-source freeze was not captured for that earlier binary. Occlusion series used 35c94b25c277afd9f1810f08d4d6f94a9861ea38c7c7a0e05cf846219482e671. Its source was captured after those runs. Final edits clarify input-mode/report limitations and configuration attribution, and add a completed-render counter plus an installed scheduling regression; final helper tests, build and lint were repeated. Do not treat the final binary as the binary measured by either series.

auxiliary_sampling.result: Completed 38 actions/33 saves and normal exit, but did not reproduce a >250 ms surface bracket (max 26.736834 ms). Aggregated samples include prepare_windows → get_current_texture → Metal acquire_texture → CAMetalLayer nextDrawable → semaphore wait. They do not pinpoint a one-second pause in this run and are not exclusive timing.

controlled_ui_attempts.unbundled: The unbundled CLI app was not addressable through the available native UI selector. Its await-cycle run was explicitly interrupted with SIGINT and returned 130, with no successful proof report.
controlled_ui_attempts.bundle: A temporary SurfaceProbe.app wrapper was attempted. Native UI launch took 348.5893 seconds and later minimize/state calls timed out. A report was produced after a notification cycle, but a subsequent relaunch hit the already-existing output guard and overwrote the wrapper log/exit file with 101. Original exit status was not preserved; controlled desktop action and presentation are unverified. Excluded from the fifteen successful comparative runs.
controlled_ui_attempts.interpretation: The await-cycle option detects notifications only. It cannot by itself prove controlled physical hide/restore. No latency claim is based on this attempt.

final_native_validation.scope: Final helper binary completed normally, with the new counter/report fields. No occlusion was observed, so this validates the active-window path and report; it does not exercise the suspension branch or establish a stall fix.

review.result: No functional blocker found by independent agent review. Corrected overbroad ordinary surface-configuration timing claim and added installed-schedule ordering test requested by review.

primary_references.finding: Reported macOS nextDrawable pause after foreground/background transitions; pattern matches, but not proof of the exact local cause.
Merged an acquisition-level occlusion check and a new surface error. Pinned wgpu-hal 27.0.4 lacks this guard.
Follow-up discusses initially invisible windows and avoiding first-draw starvation; do not blindly port an occlusion check.

next_compatibility_candidate.finding: Versioned Bevy 0.19.0 source handles CurrentSurfaceTexture::Occluded without failing the frame. A renderer-stack migration is a concrete compatibility candidate, not yet implemented or tested locally; startup regression and screenshot behavior still require validation.

decision: Keep all mitigation options test-only. Both Immediate modes fail to eliminate the pause. Event-gated parking works after notification (224, 227 and 12 parked frames, one native resume) but all three trials still pause before the notification. Next renderer work should evaluate a compatible acquisition-level fix with startup, resize, rapid hide/restore, screenshots and teardown tests; an event-only product workaround is insufficient.
limitations: Desktop occlusion/focus was not standardized; stall counts describe these runs and are not comparative probabilities or a ranking of modes.
All native action and geometry assertions passed, but no-capture runs and suspended render frames do not prove every accepted scene was displayed.
CPU scheduling brackets include scheduling and concurrent work; no GPU/input-to-presentation measurement.
Current complete placement, calibrated held-out quality, topology/override continuity, scale and human comprehension gates remain open.
